To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there is a lack of research on social and emotional learning and positive youth development in Turkey.

the majority of the articles reviewed were published in the last 10 years and that the most common topics were social skills, positive social behaviour and attitudes towards others, and attitudes towards self.
there is a lack of empirical studies in the field of positive youth development in Turkey, and there is a lack in the research on social and emotional learning and the needs of adolescents in Turkey.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social and emotional needs of adolescents in Turkey and the extent to which these needs have been addressed in research.
how social and emotional learning (SEL) can be integrated into educational policy and practice in Turkey, and how this might contribute to the development of positive youth development in Turkey.
social and emotional development and the positive youth development of adolescents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the social and emotional needs of Turkish adolescents are not being met.
the social and emotional development of adolescents in Turkey needs to be addressed more systematically in the future.
there are no comprehensive researches on the social and psychological needs of the adolescents in Turkey, which are essential for the development of social and emotional learning programmes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

social and emotional development of Turkish adolescents is an area of research that needs to be developed further, especially in relation to the development of positive youth development and social and emotional learning.
the social and emotional needs of Turkish adolescents are being addressed in a limited number of ways.
the research in Turkey has not yet reached a point where it could be used to guide the development of educational policies and programmes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the research conducted in Turkey on social and emotional learning is not sufficiently grounded in the cultural context of Turkey, and that the research has not been sufficiently informed by international trends.
the field of social and emotional learning has not been adequately addressed in Turkey, despite its importance in the development and well-being of adolescents.
social and emotional learning research is an important and promising area for future research in Turkey.
